Start with the **Basic** tutorials: together they are a crash course. Move to **Advanced** for datasets, high throughput, and specialised analyses, and to **Deeper knowledge** for how the methods work inside and how to tune them. Missing something? Open an [issue](https://github.com/mofography/mofography/issues). Every function is listed in the [API reference](reference/index.qmd).

::: {.callout-note}
## Work in progress
These tutorials are still being updated, and new and better functions and modules are added constantly, so take any single page with a grain of salt. Some pages may lag behind the latest code. For the rigorous treatment of the methods, definitions and validation, refer to the paper and its Supporting Information.
:::

## Deeper knowledge

How the methods work inside, what the knobs do, and older or niche approaches.

| Tutorial | What it covers |
|---|---|
| [Tuning and safe ranges](parameter_tuning.qmd) | Defaults, safe ranges, and symptoms for `dgrid_from_atoms_rust` and `do_periodic_segmentation_rust` |
| [Distance grid methods](dgrid_methods.qmd) | The four distance-grid backends and how to choose |
| [Selective smoothing](selective_smoothing.qmd) | `preserve_threshold`, `smooth_threshold`, `max_smooth_radius` and h-maxima |
| [Watershed backends](watershed_backends.qmd) **(new)** | `rust_det`, `rust_bucket`, `rust_det_parallel`, `skimage`: timing, memory, determinism |
| [VDW radii and segmentation](vdw_radii.qmd) | How Bondi, CRC, and Alvarez radii change the grid and pore analysis |
| [Accessibility methods](accessibility.qmd) | Winding vs lattice (Zeo++-style) accessibility, plus a 3D percolating cluster |
| [Window fingerprinting](window_fingerprinting.qmd) | Element-weighted shell fingerprints and accessible-region search |
| [Pathfinding on the pore graph](percolated_paths_tutorial.ipynb) | Dijkstra-style path finding; an example only, use the winding method for PLD and percolation |
| [Fast Rust CIF reader](fast_cif_reader.qmd) **(new)** | `read_cif_to_ase`: much faster CIF parsing for large structures |
| [Aromatic ring detection](aromatic_ring_detection.qmd) | Ring highlights and bond-length tolerances for Plotly and Three.js |
